contract: The normal SDK worker registers its signal declaration before the observer starts the original run. Two distinct normal published client processes send identical instance-scoped payloads to that current run. Three distinct author processes open the first condition wait, cold-replay the first signal into a second wait, then cold-replay both accepted signals and complete the same original run with the exact final signal payload. Preserve distinct command/signal identities, ordered acceptance/application and cursor advancement, original waits/queue/history, actual registration and fenced receipts, and exact int64/Unicode/boolean/null Avro values. Embedded uses its canonical direct-signal author; its explicitly different full history is retained and SDK language transport is inapplicable. No continuation/current-run race, run-targeted client API, all signal policies or performance claim.
